name: Cluster-P2P-round-robin
comments: The cluster test without a load balancer, for hosts where IPVS and keepalived are not
available - Windows in particular. Every client group lists all six nodes; xmq_scn
connects client i to server i modulo six, so the clients are spread across the cluster.
Subscribers are shifted by one node so a publisher and its subscriber sit on different
nodes and the cluster has to route the message.
A client whose node goes away does not stay on it: with auto_reconnect and more than one
server, each reconnect attempt asks for the next node in the list, so the client moves to
a survivor. This is not keepalived: there is no health check and no removal of a node from
the list. The load-balancer scenario stays Linux-only.
The accounts are the test cluster's: user/User-Secret1, from the cluster's shared accounts
